verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's first-party docs say it deposits checks received in your mailbox without you going to the bank. It charges per deposit with no setup or monthly fees and supports batching multiple checks together, which covers the core of hands-free deposit. Missing for 10: any documentation of how endorsement is handled, any reconciliation or deposit-confirmation reporting, details on deposit timing or destination banks, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.
